context: A teacher walks a teen through current events
purpose: Teach: 通りすがり/引っかかっ/見逃す/警部/一目瞭然/閉ざさ/見抜く/難題

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、通りすがりの一言から始まる物語、構成、丁寧ですね。
lines.en: Sakura, the way you built this story from a chance remark — it's really thoughtful.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Leaning forward slightly with genuine interest. Soft opening, measured pace. The tone of a teacher who notices something worth noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。伏線に引っかかった箇所、書き直しました。
lines.en: Yes. I found the places where the foreshadowing felt weak and rewrote them.
lines.style: Focused but not defensive. Precise diction on 'weak.' Quiet pride underneath — she knows the work was good. Brief, efficient delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 重要な手がかり、見逃すことなく、入れましたね。
lines.en: And you wove in all the crucial details without letting any slip through.
lines.style: Nod in the voice. Steady affirmation. Clear-eyed recognition of craft. Slight warmth on 'crucial' — acknowledging the difficulty of what she did.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 警部役の人物、語り口、印象深いです。
lines.en: The way your detective character speaks — there's something really distinctive about it.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before starting. Testing the thought as she speaks it. Genuine curiosity in the question; she's working it out alongside Sakura, not assessing from above.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 真相、一目瞭然の終わり方、いいですね。
lines.en: And the ending — the way the truth comes together — it's very satisfying.
lines.style: Gentle conviction. A small nod embedded in the delivery. Calm, reflective pacing. Finality without harshness — this is what works.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 過去への扉、閉ざさずに描きました。
lines.en: You left the door open to her past instead of closing it off.
lines.style: Observational, almost to herself at first. Recognition that Sakura made a choice — a good one. Slight lift at the end, inviting Sakura to see it too.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人物の心情を見抜く描写、優れていますね。
lines.en: The way you read your characters' inner lives — that's what makes this strong.
lines.style: Direct, sincere praise. Steady eye contact in the voice. No softening, no hedging. This is a real compliment, delivered plainly because Sakura respects plain language.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 残された難題、続編で書き続けます。
lines.en: There's still more to explore with them, and I think you know where that goes.
lines.style: Closing statement, gently forward-looking. Soft confidence that she'll continue. Not an ending — an opening. Warm, expectant tone.
